transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Cardholder Services. My name is Alex. How can I assist you today?
Customer: Hi Alex, I'm checking on a refund that hasn't shown up on my card yet. I sent something back and got an email, but the money isn't there.
Agent: I can certainly look into your card activity for that. May I please have your full name?
Customer: Yes, it's Barnaby Coyle.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Coyle. Could you also verify your billing zip code and the last four digits of your card?
Customer: Zip code is 98104, and the card ends in 4102.
Agent: Thank you for confirming that. Which merchant did you purchase from, and what was the date of the charge?
Customer: It was from KitchenCraft Online, and the charge went through on September 30th.
Agent: And what was the total dollar amount for that order?
Customer: It was $79.95.
Agent: Alright, I see that charge on September 30th for $79.95. Could you tell me a bit more about what occurred with the order?
Customer: Sure. I bought a blender from them, but when it arrived, I decided I didn't want it. So I mailed it back to them.
Agent: When did you mail it back, and have you heard from the company since then?
Customer: I sent it out about two weeks ago, and four business days ago they sent me an email that said return accepted, refund issued.
Agent: Have you seen any pending transactions from KitchenCraft Online since receiving that message?
Customer: No, nothing at all. I keep refreshing my app every morning, but there's no sign of the seventy-nine ninety-five coming back.
Agent: Just to make sure I have all the details recorded correctly, you returned a blender to KitchenCraft Online, the original purchase was on September 30th for $79.95, and they emailed you four business days ago stating the return was accepted and a refund was issued, but you haven't seen it appear on your account yet.
Customer: That's exactly right.
